points.description: States at least four distinct objectives of IPv6, each taken from the model answer's list (for example: supporting billions of end-systems, reducing routing tables, simplified header processing, increased security, quality of service via flow label and traffic class, multicasting, mobility/roaming, extensibility through extension headers, coexistence with existing protocols). Equivalent wording earns the mark. Repeating the same objective in different words counts only once.

rubric.notes: The question asks for at least four objectives, so the full mark goes to a student who names four or more distinct objectives from the model answer's list. Any answer naming fewer than four distinct valid objectives, or only restating one objective, gets no mark. Extra detail such as flow label or traffic class is secondary and does not need to be present.
